'''Vil''' was a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] who served with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued&mdash;condemning all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as traitors to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;Vil was [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] a [[Coruscant Security Force assault ship|CSF assault ship]] and flying patrol with a CSF [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dog]] [[Unidentified Coruscant Security officer (akk handler)|handler]] and [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic Commandos]] [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] and [[Niner Skirata|Niner]]. With some disbelief, Vil informed the commandos and their partner of the [[Coruscant Security Force Dispatch|comm traffic]] on the military [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|activity]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Vil landed the assault [[Starship/Legends|ship]] they were in, on a platform at the request of the commandos, who disembarked to contact their [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], [[Kal Skirata]].<ref name="Order66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vil appeared in ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="Order66" />
